pages.title: Wheelybug Ladybug Small
pages.description: The Wheelybug Ladybug ride on wooden toy with unlimited directional movement can go backwards, forwards, sideways, round and round
pages.ld_description:
The Wheelybug Ladybug is a ride-on wooden toy that provides unlimited directional movement. It can move backwards, forwards, sideways, and even spin around.

Designed for little adventurers, this colourful ride-on ladybug features a sturdy wooden base and a soft, black and red cover that is both cute and comfortable. With its smooth, multi-directional wheels, this Ladybug-themed toy allows kids to zoom and spin in any direction, promoting self-confidence, spatial awareness, and gross motor skills.

The Wheelybug has a padded layer of sponge covered with a durable layer of polyurethane leatheroid, making it easy to wipe clean. It works best on smooth, level floors and is ideal for indoor use.

The Wheelybug Ladybug is crafted to provide hours of robust fun while encouraging active play and imaginative adventures.

 	Ride on Ladybug toy with spring loaded eyes
 	Bodies have a padded layer of sponge covered with tough polyurethane
 	Easily wiped clean
 	For use on all level surfaces
 	Handmade and beautifully crafted from the highest quality materials
 	Multi-directional castors - rated at 30kg each giving a safe working load of 120kg
 	Unlimited mobility
 	Wooden base is made from plywood
 	All WheelyBugs are made from sustainably sourced materials
 	Handle is made from aluminium so will not rust
 	International & European Safety Tested (EN71)
 	Recommended for 1 – 3 years

 
Weight: 1.8kg
Dimensions:L39, W23.5, H31cm
